cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sit with you while you tell your brother you lost the deposit. Next time, you sit through an equally difficult admission from me. Say yes before we ring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're charging me for being frightened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not for fear. For staying while someone hears the truth. Please keep those separate. I need to know you'll take that risk with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know if I could. I'd want to make an excuse and leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'I might leave', please. 'I don't know' conceals the risk. I'll count the plain version as a first payment; you still owe me the staying.

reason: Replace an unspoken laugh with correction of the words B actually used, preserving emotional risk as a debt partly repaid.
